svg.title: Operating modes: dry-run and live
svg.desc: Two bands. The teal DRY-RUN: signal, limits, exit calculation, journal — and not one transaction. The amber LIVE: signal, limits, simulation, signing and send, confirmation, journal. It is noted that live turns on only with two switches at once: the --live flag and the LIVE_CONFIRM=yes variable.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the mode is set in lib/config.mjs: LIVE = the --live flag is present and --dry-run is not

svg.text: Two switches at once: the --live flag AND the LIVE_CONFIRM=yes variable. One flag alone is not enough — the bot stops before connecting to the network.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If the simulation failed, the transaction is not sent: otherwise it would pay the fee and fall on the network.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A post-migration PumpSwap sell additionally requires LIVE_CONFIRM_AMM=yes: this path is not yet verified on a real transaction.
